title: Practice 19: The present tense: the Е and И types

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: The letter с in the infinitive form писать is replaced by the letter ш in all forms of the present tense.
